commands.name: lp
commands.label: LuckPerms help
commands.description: Prints a list of the LuckPerms commands the sender has permission to use, with brief information about each.

commands.name: lp-sync
commands.label: Sync data
commands.description: Performs a refresh of all currently loaded data from storage.

commands.name: lp-info
commands.label: Plugin info
commands.description: Lists information about LuckPerms, including debugging output, statistics, settings and important configuration values.

commands.name: lp-editor
commands.label: Open web editor
commands.description: Opens a web editor session to edit permissions data; saved changes must be applied with the command it gives.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.label: User filter
inputs.placeholder: Only include users whose nodes start with this

commands.name: lp-applyedits
commands.label: Apply web editor changes
commands.description: Applies the changes saved in a web editor session using the code it generated.

commands.name: lp-trusteditor
commands.label: Trust editor session
commands.description: Explicitly trusts a connected web editor session so its changes can be applied without running a command.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: Session id
inputs.placeholder: Id shown by the web editor

commands.name: lp-verbose
commands.label: Verbose logging
commands.description: Controls the verbose system that listens for permission checks: on, record, off or upload the recorded output.

commands.name: lp-verbose-command
commands.label: Verbose check a command
commands.description: Executes a command as the given player and lists all permission checks made for that command.

commands.name: lp-tree
commands.label: Permission tree
commands.description: Generates a tree view of the permissions registered to the server.

commands.name: lp-search
commands.label: Search permission
commands.description: Searches all users and groups for a specific permission and returns a paginated list of found entries.

commands.name: lp-networksync
commands.label: Network sync
commands.description: Refreshes all cached data from storage and asks all other connected servers to sync too.

commands.name: lp-import
commands.label: Import data
commands.description: Imports data into LuckPerms from a file or a web export code; --replace overwrites the existing setup instead of merging.

commands.name: lp-export
commands.label: Export data
commands.description: Exports LuckPerms data into a file in the plugin directory, or to the web with --upload.

commands.name: lp-reloadconfig
commands.label: Reload config
commands.description: Reloads some values from the configuration file; some settings require a full restart.

commands.name: lp-bulkupdate
commands.label: Bulk update
commands.description: Performs a bulk modification to all permission data (console only).

commands.name: lp-translations
commands.label: Translations info
commands.description: Shows information about loaded translations.

commands.name: lp-translations-install
commands.label: Install translations
commands.description: Installs or updates the latest community provided translation bundles.

commands.name: lp-creategroup
commands.label: Create group
commands.description: Creates a new group.

commands.name: lp-deletegroup
commands.label: Delete group
commands.description: Permanently deletes a group.

commands.name: lp-listgroups
commands.label: List groups
commands.description: Displays a list of all current groups.

commands.name: lp-createtrack
commands.label: Create track
commands.description: Creates a new track.

commands.name: lp-deletetrack
commands.label: Delete track
commands.description: Permanently deletes a track.

commands.name: lp-listtracks
commands.label: List tracks
commands.description: Displays a list of all current tracks.

commands.name: lp-user-info
commands.label: User info
commands.description: Displays information about a user, including their username, primary group, parents and current contexts.

commands.name: lp-user-editor
commands.label: User web editor
commands.description: Opens a web editor session to edit the permissions of the specified user.

commands.name: lp-user-promote
commands.label: Promote user
commands.description: Promotes a user along a track, adding them to the first group if they are not on it yet.

commands.name: lp-user-demote
commands.label: Demote user
commands.description: Demotes a user down a track.

commands.name: lp-user-showtracks
commands.label: User tracks
commands.description: Displays a list of all of the tracks a user is currently on.

commands.name: lp-user-clear
commands.label: Clear user
commands.description: Clears the user's permissions, parent groups and meta.

commands.name: lp-user-clone
commands.label: Clone user
commands.description: Clones the user's data onto another user.

commands.name: lp-group-info
commands.label: Group info
commands.description: Displays information about a group.

commands.name: lp-group-editor
commands.label: Group web editor
commands.description: Opens a web editor session to edit the permissions of the specified group.

commands.name: lp-group-listmembers
commands.label: List group members
commands.description: Lists the users and groups which inherit directly from this group.

commands.name: lp-group-setweight
commands.label: Set group weight
commands.description: Sets the group's weight, which determines the order groups are considered in; higher value means higher weight.

commands.name: lp-group-setdisplayname
commands.label: Set group display name
commands.description: Sets the group's display name, which can act as an alias for the group.

commands.name: lp-group-showtracks
commands.label: Group tracks
commands.description: Displays a list of all of the tracks a group is currently on.

commands.name: lp-group-clear
commands.label: Clear group
commands.description: Clears the group's permissions, parent groups and meta.

commands.name: lp-group-rename
commands.label: Rename group
commands.description: Changes a group's name; existing members still point to the old name.

commands.name: lp-group-clone
commands.label: Clone group
commands.description: Makes an exact copy of the group under a different name.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-info
commands.label: User permissions
commands.description: Displays a list of the permission nodes a user has.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-set
commands.label: Set user permission
commands.description: Sets a permission for a user; a value of false negates it, and no context means global.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-unset
commands.label: Unset user permission
commands.description: Unsets (removes) a permission for a user.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-settemp
commands.label: Set temporary user permission
commands.description: Sets a permission temporarily for a user until the duration expires.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-unsettemp
commands.label: Unset temporary user permission
commands.description: Unsets a temporary permission for a user, or subtracts a duration from it.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-check
commands.label: Check user permission
commands.description: Checks whether a user has a certain permission and what influenced the result.

commands.name: lp-user-permission-clear
commands.label: Clear user permissions
commands.description: Removes all permissions from the user.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-info
commands.label: User parents
commands.description: Displays a list of the user's parent groups (groups they inherit from).

commands.name: lp-user-parent-set
commands.label: Set user parent
commands.description: Sets the user's parent, clearing all existing parent groups in the given context.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-add
commands.label: Add user parent
commands.description: Adds a parent group to the user without removing existing parents.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-remove
commands.label: Remove user parent
commands.description: Removes a parent group from the user.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-settrack
commands.label: Set user track position
commands.description: Sets the user's position on a track, clearing only existing parents on that track.

inputs.name: group
inputs.label: Group or index
inputs.placeholder: Group name or position on the track

commands.name: lp-user-parent-addtemp
commands.label: Add temporary user parent
commands.description: Adds a parent group to the user temporarily until the duration expires.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-removetemp
commands.label: Remove temporary user parent
commands.description: Removes a temporary parent from the user, or subtracts a duration from it.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-clear
commands.label: Clear user parents
commands.description: Removes all parents the user has, adding them back to the default group.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-cleartrack
commands.label: Clear user parents on track
commands.description: Removes all parents from the user on a given track.

commands.name: lp-user-parent-switchprimarygroup
commands.label: Switch primary group
commands.description: Changes a user's primary group, adding them to it if they are not already a member.

commands.name: lp-user-meta-info
commands.label: User meta
commands.description: Displays the user's inherited meta, prefixes and suffixes.

commands.name: lp-user-meta-set
commands.label: Set user meta
commands.description: Sets a meta key-value pair for the user.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.placeholder: Wrap in quotes if it contains spaces

commands.name: lp-user-meta-unset
commands.label: Unset user meta
commands.description: Unsets a meta key-value pair for the user.

commands.name: lp-user-meta-settemp
commands.label: Set temporary user meta
commands.description: Sets a temporary meta key-value pair for the user.

inputs.name: value

inputs.placeholder: Wrap in quotes if it contains spaces

commands.name: lp-user-meta-unsettemp
commands.label: Unset temporary user meta
commands.description: Unsets a temporary meta key-value pair for the user.

commands.label: Add user prefix
commands.description: Adds a prefix to the user at the given priority.

inputs.name: prefix

inputs.placeholder: Wrap in quotes to keep spaces, e.g. "&c[Admin] "

commands.name: lp-user-meta-setprefix
commands.label: Set user prefix

commands.name: lp-track-editor
commands.label: Track web editor
commands.description: Opens a web editor session to edit the specified track.

commands.name: lp-track-append
commands.label: Append group to track
commands.description: Adds a group onto the end of the track.

commands.name: lp-track-insert
commands.label: Insert group into track
commands.description: Inserts a group at a specific position in the track; position 1 is the start.

commands.name: lp-track-remove
commands.label: Remove group from track
commands.description: Removes a group from the track.

commands.name: lp-track-clear
commands.label: Clear track
commands.description: Removes all groups from the track.

commands.label: Rename track
commands.description: Changes a track's name.

commands.name: lp-track-clone
commands.label: Clone track
commands.description: Makes an exact copy of the track under a different name.

commands.name: lp-log-recent
commands.label: Recent actions
commands.description: Shows a list of recent actions, optionally filtered by the user who performed them.

inputs.name: query

commands.label: Log notifications
